name: Turi

skills.name: Weapon master
skills.description: This skill allows you to wield one handed-spears, two-handed weapons, pole-arms and pikes.

skills.name: Magician
skills.description: You are able to cast the three basic spells; detect magic, operate portal and create bond up to four times per day. You may purchase additional spells and mana.

skills.name: Night lore
skills.description: You can perform night rituals and have two night rituals mastered. Further purchases of this skill improve your mastery of night magic.

skills.name: Artisan
skills.description: During the downtime between events, you may craft up to three magical items using rare materials that you have in your possession.

rituals.name: Conclave of Trees and Shadow
rituals.description: Transforms a forest into a powerful military unit for a season.

rituals.name: Eight-spoked Wheel
rituals.description: Transforms three ingots or measures of materials along an alchemical path.

spells.name: Create Bond
spells.description: You may bond a willing target to a suitable item or group. Other than potions and herbs, most magical items can only be used if the user is bonded to the item. You may also break such a bond if the target or the item is present.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Discern the level and realm of an enchantment that a single target close enough to touch is under. You can also use this spell to discern the level and realm of a ritual that is being cast if you are close enough to hear the words of the ritual. A referee is required to cast this spell.

spells.name: Operate Portal
spells.description: You may open a portal to another location, or trace to where a portal was last opened to go to. Magicians can use portals to travel to the Hall of Worlds where they can treat with Eternals as well as using them to travel to other locations in the Empire.

Learn Item Items Artisan's Oil ( Consumable ) Using 10 seconds of appropriate roleplaying the artisan This oil repairs an item, such as a weapon or shield that has been broken using the SHATTER call. Requires: 1 crown Enigmatic Staff ( Ritual staff ) Gain one rank of Night Lore, subject to the normal rules for effective skill. Requires: 11 measures of ambergelt 14 measures of iridescent gloaming 20 measures of dragonbone Hero's Girdle ( Mage armour ) You gain one additional rank of endurance. Requires: Mask of Gold and Lead ( Foci ) Gain 1 rank for The Eight-Spoked Wheel, The Retrograde Wheel, Distil the Serpent's Stone, and Amalgamation of Silver and Gold rituals, subject to the normal rules for effective skill. In addition, for each contributor to either the Eight-Spoked Wheel or the Retrograde wheel who wears one of these masks, three additional ingots or measures of material can be transmuted without increasing the magnitude of the ritual. All measures or ingots targeted by one of these rituals must be of the same type as usual. Requires: 5 measures of beggars lye 3 measures of iridescent gloaming 3 measures of dragonbone

In-character Information Background Currently residing near Greenfalls in Miaren. Interested alchemy, primarily discovering the ways that materials can be transformed via the Eight Spoked Wheel and how they remain without reverting or requiring additional resources to remain changed.
